items.title: Coding Is the New Excel
items.dek: My head of content opened a pull request this morning. Coding is not hard anymore, and it is becoming part of the job the way spreadsheets did.
items.author: Julian Kreth

items.title: We Packed Our Whole Agency Into a Claude Code Plugin
items.dek: Fifty people, one install command. What Claude Code plugins actually are, and a tour of the Masse Workbench.
items.author: Julian Kreth

items.title: Cursor, Codex, Claude Code: What I Use for Which
items.dek: I do not rank coding agents. I route jobs: Cursor for the screen, Claude Code for the team, Codex when I want a long run I can leave alone.
items.author: Julian Kreth

items.title: An LLM Is One Brain Region Pretending to Be a Whole Brain
items.dek: We have been comparing chatbots to brains. Wrong metaphor. A brain is more like a chip: many systems lighting up together. An LLM is closer to one of those regions.
items.author: Julian Kreth

items.title: Leaving Notes for the Robots: Do AI Agents Follow Instructions on Pages That Rank?
items.dek: What happens when you put instructions for agents on pages that already rank, and whether crawlers and agents actually follow them.
items.author: Julian Kreth
